why: Built 23 Sep 2026 after Joana found a TRIS notification (Spain 2026/0266/ES, the textile and footwear decree) that Brubru had not seen. The source list for a client must not be drawn only from our side: every source the client reads, or that bears on their remit, is listed here with a freshness test, and anything we do not ingest is listed as a gap rather than left out.

sources.name: TRIS: national draft technical rules (Directive (EU) 2015/1535)
sources.why: Member States notify draft rules on textiles, packaging, waste and labelling here before adoption; the standstill is the window to react.

sources.name: WTO technical barriers to trade (TBT) notifications
sources.why: Third-country technical rules affecting EU textile and product exporters.

sources.name: JRC Product Bureau (ESPR methodology consultation, textile preparatory study)
sources.sql: SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'dpp' AND guid LIKE 'jrc-pb-%'
sources.why: The methodological reports and the textile study are drafted here before any delegated act.

sources.name: Commission Have Your Say consultations
sources.sql: SELECT max(scraped_at) FROM public_consultations WHERE source = 'commission'
sources.why: Feedback windows on ESPR delegated acts, including the apparel-textiles act (initiative 16116).

sources.name: Ecodesign Forum and Member States Expert Group (expert groups register)
sources.sql: SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM economy_items WHERE item_type = 'expert_group'
sources.why: Where sector requirements are first discussed (ESPR Articles 19 and 20).

sources.name: EU legal corpus (Cellar)
sources.why: Full text of the acts the DPP connector quotes.

sources.name: Commission DPP news and events (DPP corpus)
sources.sql: SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'dpp' AND item_type IN ('news','event') AND guid NOT LIKE 'jrc-pb-%'
sources.why: Registry and passport announcements and webinars.

sources.name: ECHA news
sources.sql: SELECT max(document_date) FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'echa' AND item_type IN ('news','press_release')
sources.why: Substances of concern: an ESPR information requirement and a textile issue.

sources.name: European Environment Agency news
sources.sql: SELECT max(document_date) FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'eea' AND item_type IN ('news','press_release')

sources.name: CINEA (LIFE programme, funds DPP-TEX)
sources.sql: SELECT max(document_date) FROM economy_items WHERE body_code = 'cinea' AND item_type IN ('news','press_release')

sources.name: BOE (Spanish official gazette)
sources.why: Where the Spanish textile and footwear Royal Decree will be published once adopted. Not ingested: a gap.

sources.name: DOGC (Official Gazette of the Government of Catalonia)
sources.why: Catalan waste and circular economy rules, Terraqui's home ground. Not ingested: a gap.

sources.name: CEN-CENELEC JTC 24 (DPP standards committee) drafts
sources.why: Draft DPP standards before publication. Not ingested: drafts sit behind national standards body membership; only the six published EN standards are in the corpus.
